move: stripes slash, words snap, phone slams up, screens slide left
how: Two stripes slash in from opposite sides (xPercent ∓120, expo.out) then drift slowly across the whole loop; 'Run' snaps up and 'Faster' snaps down out of masks; a phone from() y:1400 rotation -8 with expo.out and tilts rotationY -6→6 with sine.inOut for 8s. Screen A (0.09-0.37D): distance counts to 6.42 with power2.out while a route path draws with DrawSVG and a marker dot follows it with MotionPath over 2.2s. Screens cut by sliding xPercent -100 out / 100 in with expo.inOut 0.45s at 0.37D and 0.64D: screen B fills a ring via strokeDashoffset and pops seven bars with back.out(2), screen C cascades leaderboard rows from x:120 and highlights the user's row. At 0.92D the phone drops back down, words and tag shove out, stripes exit.
adapt: Change the two hero words, tag, screen titles, list items, count targets, route path and accent colour; keep the 0.45s expo.inOut screen swipe cadence and the 0.9s phone slam.
port: mount(el, shot) builds stripes, hero words, a .phone with three .scr screens (route SVG, ring SVG, generated bars, lists) and .tag; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with DrawSVG and MotionPath registered, the proxy count tweens (onUpdate paint) and offsets as fractions of D (screen A 0.9/10, B 3.7/10, C 6.4/10, exit 9.2/10). paint() and the motionPath path reference must be scoped to el.
caveats: paint() uses document.querySelector and must be scoped
